description: Benchmark evaluation suite for a11y-audit skill adhering to WCAG 2.2 AA standards

cases.description: Explicit form label association and aria-describedby linkage
cases.prompt: Create an accessible form field with explicit label htmlFor association and error description.

assertions.description: Associates label with input via htmlFor
Links input to helper text or error message container

cases.description: Keyboard focus trap using tabbable and focus restoration
cases.prompt: Implement focus trapping in a modal dialog using tabbable and restore focus upon closing.

assertions.description: Transfers focus to first tabbable node

cases.description: Polite screen reader announcements with zero Oxford commas
cases.prompt: Trigger a polite screen reader announcement informing the user that sections have been reordered.

assertions.description: Uses polite live region for assistive technology announcements
Announcement string must not contain Oxford commas

cases.description: Keyboard sensors and ARIA sortable attributes for @dnd-kit lists
cases.prompt: Configure KeyboardSensor and sortableKeyboardCoordinates on a sortable list component.

assertions.description: Applies accessible role description for sortable items
